data.name: Agent_StartFailed
data.value: The agent did not respond. Check agent.log in the data folder.

data.name: Agent_NeededForThis
data.value: This needs the agent to be running.

data.name: Firewall_Title
data.value: The phone cannot reach this PC over Wi-Fi

data.name: Firewall_Missing
data.value: The Windows Firewall rule "Ven4Docking" is missing. The agent is running, but connections from your home network are not let in, so the phone panel will not load.

data.name: Firewall_Blocked
data.value: Windows Firewall blocks incoming connections to the agent (this happens if "Cancel" was pressed in its prompt). The agent is running, but the phone panel will not load.

data.name: Firewall_FixHint
data.value: Windows will ask for administrator rights: the agent adds the "Ven4Docking" rule (local network only) and removes the block.

data.name: Firewall_Declined
data.value: Administrator rights were not granted, so the rule was not added. Press "Fix" again and answer "Yes".

data.name: Firewall_StillReported
data.value: The rule was added, but the agent still reports a problem. Restart the agent or press "Fix" again.

data.name: Firewall_FailedCode
data.value: Could not add the rule (code {0}). See agent.log in the data folder.

data.name: Saved_Agent
data.value: Saved to the agent, layout version {0}. The panel rebuilds itself.

data.name: SaveError_Bounds
data.value: Not saved: a block is outside the grid ({0}).

data.name: SaveError_Screens
data.value: Not saved: there must be 1 to 10 screens.

data.name: Ask_SaveBeforeSwitch
data.value: There are unsaved changes. Save before switching the phone?

data.name: Ask_SaveOnExit
data.value: There are unsaved changes. Save before exit?

data.name: Screens_Max
data.value: There can be at most 10 screens.

data.name: Screens_PaletteHint
data.value: Drag a block onto the grid or double-click it.

data.name: Screens_PreviewHint
data.value: 8×4 grid at the phone's resolution. Move blocks with the mouse; resize with the bottom-right corner.

data.name: Screens_NoRoom
data.value: No free space on this screen — shrink or delete a block.

data.name: Screens_NoWebView
data.value: WebView2 Runtime not found — no preview, the grid still works.

data.name: Screens_SkeletonNote
data.value: Block outline · the real panel appears when the agent runs or panel/dist is built

data.name: Props_Empty
data.value: Select a block on the grid or drag a new one from the list on the left.

data.name: Opts_EmptyList
data.value: The list is empty — add items in their section.

data.name: Phones_Subtitle
data.value: Connected panels, pairing requests and the connection wizard.

data.name: Phones_AgentOffline
data.value: The agent is not running: phones come from config.json; pairing requests and revoking are unavailable.

data.name: Phones_EmptyHint
data.value: Press «Connect a phone» — the wizard installs the launcher and sets everything up. Or open Ven4Docking on the phone and confirm the code here.

data.name: Phone_RevokeConfirm
data.value: Revoke access of “{0}”? The panel stops getting data until the phone is paired again.

data.name: Phone_NotInAgent
data.value: Data appears when the agent is running

data.name: Phone_DimOffline
data.value: Dim when the PC does not respond

data.name: Cable_Text
data.value: With the phone connected by cable, Ven4Docking can always update the launcher (with the button in «Phones») and restore settings. Wi-Fi debugging turns off after a reboot or a network change. Without debugging, settings must be changed by hand.

data.name: Wizard_WifiHint
data.value: Android 11 and newer only, pairing by code.

data.name: Adb_NeedText
data.value: Setting up the phone needs Google's adb. Google's license does not let us ship it in our installer, so Ven4Docking downloads it from dl.google.com — only with your consent.

data.name: Adb_Consent_Text
data.value:
Ven4Docking will download Android SDK Platform-Tools (about 7 MB) from Google: https://dl.google.com/android/repository/platform-tools-latest-windows.zip
They will be saved to: {0}
These are Google's programs under Google's Android SDK license. By downloading you accept its terms. Nothing else is sent.
Download?

data.name: Adb_Declined
data.value: Without platform-tools the wizard cannot set up the phone. You can set it up by hand or come back later.

data.name: Wifi_Steps
data.value: On the phone: Developer options → Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code. Enter the address and code it shows, then the address from the Wireless debugging screen itself.

data.name: Wifi_ConnectAddress
data.value: Connection address and port (from the Wireless debugging screen)

data.name: Wifi_FillPair
data.value: Enter the address with port and the pairing code.

data.name: Wifi_FillConnect
data.value: Enter the address with port to connect.

data.name: Wifi_Paired
data.value: Paired. Now connect using the address from the Wireless debugging screen.

data.name: Brand_KeepAlive
data.value: So the phone does not close the panel (by hand)

data.name: Brand_MayDiffer
data.value: The item may be named differently — search for it in the settings.

data.name: Wizard_NoDevices
data.value: No phone visible. Turn on debugging as described on the left and connect the cable.

data.name: Wizard_Unauthorized
data.value: Confirm «Allow USB debugging?» on the phone and press refresh.

data.name: Wizard_DetectFailed
data.value: Could not read the Android version.

data.name: Wizard_TooOld
data.value: Android {0} is not supported: Android 7 or newer is required.

data.name: Wizard_SetupHint
data.value: Commands are chosen for the Android version; each result is checked.

data.name: Wizard_Item_timeZone
data.value: Time zone as on the PC

data.name: Wizard_Manual_NoLock
data.value: On Android 7 do it by hand: Settings → Security → Screen lock → None.

data.name: Wizard_Manual_TimeZone
data.value: The phone did not allow changing the zone from the PC. Set it by hand: Settings → Date and time.

data.name: Wizard_Manual_Generic
data.value: Do this by hand in the phone's settings.

data.name: Launcher_Hint
data.value: The launcher is updated from the PC with the button in this section — by cable or over Wi-Fi debugging, as at the first install. The phone itself downloads and installs nothing.

data.name: Launcher_NoApk
data.value: There is no launcher file next to the editor (apk\ven4docking.apk). Reinstall Ven4Docking.

data.name: Launcher_Searching
data.value: Looking for the phone over adb…

data.name: Launcher_NoDevice
data.value: The phone is not visible over adb. Connect it by cable with «USB debugging» on or, on Android 11+, over «Wireless debugging» in the connection wizard, then press the button again.

data.name: Launcher_Unauthorized
data.value: The phone should show «Allow USB debugging?» — tap «Allow» and try again.

data.name: Launcher_ChooseDevice
data.value: Several devices are connected — pick the phone and press «Install».

data.name: Launcher_Done
data.value: Launcher {0} is installed on {1} and started. The card shows the new version once the phone reports in.

data.name: Launcher_DoneNoVersion
data.value: The launcher is installed on {0}, but the phone did not report its version — check that the panel opened.

data.name: AdbErr_signature
data.value: the phone has a launcher with another signature (for example a test build). Remove Ven4Docking from the phone and install it again with the wizard.

data.name: AdbErr_downgrade
data.value: the phone has a newer version than this file.

data.name: AdbErr_storage
data.value: the phone is out of storage.

data.name: AdbErr_userRestricted
data.value: the phone refused installing over USB. On Xiaomi turn on «Install via USB» in Developer options; on other phones confirm the install on the screen.

data.name: AdbErr_aborted
data.value: the install was cancelled on the phone.

data.name: AdbErr_unauthorized
data.value: the phone did not allow debugging from this PC.

data.name: AdbErr_offline
data.value: the phone went offline — reconnect the cable.

data.name: AdbErr_timeout
data.value: adb did not answer in time.

data.name: AdbErr_permission
data.value: the phone's shell refused the command.

data.name: Wizard_PermissionDenied
data.value: The phone refused settings changes from the PC.

data.name: Wizard_DeniedTitle
data.value: The phone's skin blocks settings over adb

data.name: Wizard_SetupDenied
data.value: Some settings were refused by the phone — see the hint and press Retry.

data.name: Wizard_SetupFailed
data.value: Some steps failed — see the details in the list.

data.name: Wizard_TokenText
data.value: The editor creates an access key for the phone and passes it to the launcher together with the PC address — no code needed. The phone and the PC must be on the same network.

data.name: Wizard_TokenSent
data.value: The phone is linked, the panel is opening.

data.name: WebView_Text
data.value: The panel runs inside the phone's WebView. Old versions get a simplified panel.

data.name: WebView_Unknown
data.value: Could not read the WebView version.

data.name: WebView_Old
data.value: WebView older than 57: the panel will be simplified (no CSS Grid). If possible, update Android System WebView or Chrome.

data.name: Charge_Text
data.value: The panel is on charge around the clock. To keep the battery from swelling, hold the charge near 80 %:

data.name: Done_Text
data.value: The phone is ready. Screens and blocks are set up in «Screens» — changes reach the panel by themselves after Save.

data.name: Ven4verse_Line
data.value: Ven4Docking is part of the Ven4verse family.

data.name: Apps_Subtitle
data.value: What the panel may launch. Drag to reorder.

data.name: Apps_ReorderHint
data.value: Drag a row to change the order of icons on the panel.

data.name: Apps_Empty
data.value: The list is empty. Add programs from the Start menu.

data.name: Apps_SelectHint
data.value: Select an app to edit it.

data.name: Apps_Target
data.value: What to launch (path, link or command)

data.name: Apps_SecurityNote
data.value: The panel can launch only what is in this list.

data.name: Servers_Subtitle
data.value: Servers for the «Servers» block: the agent connects over SSH with your key from %USERPROFILE%\.ssh.

data.name: Servers_KeyHint
data.value: “auto” — id_ed25519 or id_rsa from %USERPROFILE%\.ssh. The host key is checked against known_hosts.

data.name: ServerErr_timeout
data.value: The server did not answer in time (timeout).

data.name: ServerErr_portClosed
data.value: The port is closed or the server is unreachable.

data.name: ServerErr_keyRejected
data.value: The server did not accept the key.

data.name: ServerErr_hostKeyMismatch
data.value: The host key does not match known_hosts — the server may have been reinstalled, or it is not the right server.

data.name: ServerErr_hostKeyUnknown
data.value: The server is not in known_hosts. Connect once with ssh and verify the fingerprint.

data.name: ServerErr_dns
data.value: Could not resolve the server name.

data.name: Ai_Subtitle
data.value: Limit sources for the «AI limits» block.

data.name: Ai_SafetyNote
data.value: Ven4Docking reads only files the programs themselves write to disk, and local APIs without an account. No tokens, passwords or private service endpoints are used — your account cannot get banned for it.

data.name: Ai_OfflineNote
data.value: The agent is not running — known sources are listed; on/off is saved to config.json.

data.name: Settings_WeatherNote
data.value: Search uses open-meteo.com. The phone gets the weather from there too.

data.name: Settings_Autostart
data.value: Start the agent when signing in to Windows

data.name: Settings_BadPort
data.value: Port must be a number from 1024 to 65535.

data.name: Settings_PortRestart
data.value: The new port works after the agent restarts. The firewall rule has to be updated too.

data.name: Settings_SaveHint
data.value: Theme and language apply at once; they reach config.json after Save.

data.name: About_Text
data.value: An old Android phone as a wall touch panel for the PC. MIT.

data.name: About_Privacy
data.value: No telemetry. Network use is limited to open-meteo (weather), GitHub (update check), dl.google.com (platform-tools, with consent) and SSH to your servers.

data.name: Update_NoReleases
data.value: No releases yet — nothing to check.

data.name: Update_Hint
data.value: The installer is downloaded from GitHub, checked against SHA256SUMS and installed silently; the agent and the editor restart by themselves.

data.name: Update_Starting
data.value: The installer is running — the editor closes and opens again.

data.name: Update_AskSave
data.value: There are unsaved changes. Save before updating?

data.name: Update_SaveFailed
data.value: The update did not start: saving failed ({0}).

data.name: Update_Err_NoAsset
data.value: The release has no required file ({0}). Download the installer from the release page.

data.name: Update_Err_NoChecksum
data.value: SHA256SUMS has no checksum for {0} — an unchecked file is not installed. Download the installer from the release page.

data.name: Update_Err_BadHost
data.value: A release file points outside GitHub ({0}) — the download was stopped.

data.name: Update_Err_Network
data.value: Could not download the update: {0}. Check the internet connection and retry, or open the release page.

data.name: Update_Err_HashMismatch
data.value: The downloaded installer did not match SHA256SUMS and was deleted. Retry later or download it from the release page.

data.name: Update_Err_Disk
data.value: Could not save the installer to the temporary folder: {0}

data.name: Agent_TooOld
data.value: The agent cannot do this — update Ven4Docking to 1.1.

data.name: SaveError_ProgramScreens
data.value: Not saved: there can be at most {0} program screens.

data.name: SaveError_NoMainScreen
data.value: Not saved: at least one normal screen (not a program screen) is needed.

data.name: Issue_ProgramScreens
data.value: More than {0} program screens: turn the extra ones into normal screens.

data.name: Issue_NoMainScreen
data.value: Every screen is a program screen: the panel has nothing to show normally.

data.name: Opts_PowerButtons
data.value: Which buttons (they act after a 2 s hold)

data.name: Opts_PowerHint
data.value: Restart and shutdown start after 10 s — the panel shows «Cancel».

data.name: Opts_KeysHint
data.value: Actions are set up in the «Buttons» section.

data.name: Opts_ObsHint
data.value: OBS address and password are in «Settings» → «OBS».

data.name: Opts_NotifyHint
data.value: Which apps to show and how — in the «Notifications» section.

data.name: Screens_ForAppHint
data.value: For example obs64.exe. Such a screen is not in the swipe order: the panel offers it while the program runs. Empty — a normal screen.

data.name: Screens_ProgramsRefresh
data.value: Refresh the list of running programs

data.name: Screens_ProgramsOffline
data.value: The agent is not running — type the exe name.

data.name: Hotkey_Unsupported
data.value: The panel cannot press this key

data.name: Hotkey_ToolTip
data.value: Click and press the combination on the keyboard.

data.name: Buttons_Subtitle
data.value: Actions for the «Buttons» block: key combinations, ready-made text, chains of steps, microphone and sound output.

data.name: Buttons_Warning
data.value: Key presses do not reach programs run as administrator, and some games with anti-cheat ignore them. The agent runs without administrator rights and will not work around this.

data.name: Buttons_DiscordHint
data.value: Ctrl+Shift+M — microphone, Ctrl+Shift+D — sound. The combinations must match Discord → Settings → Keybinds.

data.name: Buttons_DiscordAdded
data.value: Added «Discord: microphone» (Ctrl+Shift+M) and «Discord: sound» (Ctrl+Shift+D). Check that Discord → Settings → Keybinds has the same combinations.

data.name: Buttons_RecordHint
data.value: Click the «Combination» field and press the keys.

data.name: Buttons_ListHint
data.value: Drag a row to change the order. Which actions the panel shows is set in the «Buttons» block on a screen.

data.name: Buttons_Empty
data.value: No actions. Add a key combination or the Discord template.

data.name: Buttons_SelectHint
data.value: Select an action to change it.

data.name: Buttons_KeysHint
data.value: Modifiers Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win and one key: a letter, a digit, F1–F24, arrows, Enter, Esc and so on.

data.name: Buttons_TextHint
data.value: Typed into the window that has the cursor; a line break is Enter.

data.name: Buttons_StepsHint
data.value: From 1 to 20 steps. «Launch an app» takes a program from the «Apps» section.

data.name: Buttons_MaxSteps
data.value: A chain has at most {0} steps.

data.name: Buttons_MicHint
data.value: Mutes and unmutes the default Windows microphone. The panel button is red while the microphone is muted.

data.name: Buttons_DevicesHint
data.value: Each press makes the next checked device the default output.

data.name: Buttons_FewDevices
data.value: Check at least two devices, otherwise there is nothing to switch between.

data.name: Buttons_DevicesOffline
data.value: The device list appears when the agent runs.

data.name: Buttons_DevicesNone
data.value: The agent found no sound output devices.

data.name: Buttons_BlockHint
data.value: To show the button on the phone, check it in a «Buttons» block in the «Screens» section.

data.name: ActionIssue_badId
data.value: Bad id: Latin letters, digits, «-» and «_» only, up to 64 characters.

data.name: ActionIssue_duplicateId
data.value: Another action has the same id.

data.name: ActionIssue_badKeys
data.value: The combination is not set or cannot be pressed.

data.name: ActionIssue_textTooLong
data.value: The text is longer than 2000 characters.

data.name: ActionIssue_stepCount
data.value: A chain must have 1 to 20 steps.

data.name: ActionIssue_unknownApp
data.value: Pick an app from the «Apps» section.

data.name: Notify_Subtitle
data.value: Windows notifications on the phone: from which apps and how much to show.

data.name: Notify_EnabledHint
data.value: Off — the agent does not read notifications at all.

data.name: Notify_WallCountsOnlyHint
data.value: No titles or text whatever an app is set to: handy when others can see the phone.

data.name: Notify_NightFlash
data.value: Light up a new notification at night

data.name: Notify_NightFlashHint
data.value: The panel raises the brightness for 5 seconds.

data.name: Notify_AccessWhere
data.value: It is turned on in «Settings» → «Privacy & security» → «Notifications» → «Notification access».

data.name: Notify_AccessUnknown
data.value: Unknown — the agent is not running or did not answer.

data.name: Notify_AccessDenied
data.value: Denied in Windows settings: the panel will show no notifications.

data.name: Notify_AccessUnspecified
data.value: Windows has not asked yet. Open settings and allow access.

data.name: Notify_AccessOff
data.value: The agent does not read notifications now.

data.name: Notify_AppsHint
data.value: Apps the agent has seen notifications from since it started. Apps set to «Hide» are not shown on the panel.

data.name: Notify_NoApps
data.value: None yet. The list grows as notifications arrive.

data.name: Notify_Offline
data.value: The agent is not running: only apps already set in config.json are shown.

data.name: Settings_ObsPasswordHint
data.value: Stored only encrypted (DPAPI, your Windows account). An empty field keeps the password.

data.name: Settings_ObsBadHost
data.value: The OBS address is this PC (127.0.0.1, localhost) or a home network address (192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x and so on): the agent does not connect to OBS over the internet.

data.name: Settings_ObsHint
data.value: Address, port and password are in OBS → «Tools» → «WebSocket Server Settings». Enable the server there too.

data.name: Settings_ObsBadPort
data.value: The OBS port is a number from 1 to 65535.

data.name: Settings_WolText
data.value: The phone can turn the PC on with «Turn on PC» when it does not answer. It needs the MAC of the network card and the broadcast address of the network.

data.name: Settings_WolSaved
data.value: The address is set by hand and goes to config.json on «Save».

data.name: Settings_WolWakeOn
data.value: Wake on LAN is allowed in Windows.

data.name: Settings_WolWakeOff
data.value: Wake on LAN is off in Windows: «Device Manager» → network adapter → «Power Management» → «Allow this device to wake the computer».

data.name: Settings_WolWakeUnknown
data.value: Could not find out whether Wake on LAN is allowed in Windows.

data.name: Settings_WolOffline
data.value: The agent is not running: the adapter address appears when it runs. You can enter it by hand.

data.name: Settings_WolNotFound
data.value: The agent found no adapter with a network route. Enter the MAC and address by hand.

data.name: Settings_WolBadMac
data.value: A MAC address is six pairs of hex digits, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

data.name: Settings_WolBadBroadcast
data.value: The broadcast address is IPv4, for example 192.168.1.255.

data.name: Settings_WolBios
data.value: Waking must also be allowed in BIOS/UEFI — the option is usually called «Wake on LAN», «Power On By PCI-E» or similar. A PC usually cannot be woken over Wi-Fi — a cable is needed.
